question: Related Questions Q. I am inquiring about the interpretation of a dream that I saw: I?m walking with my mother on a pathway, and she supposedly is carrying my child. In my dream I think to myself, how that is possible, as I am not married nor have I committed the haram (zina). Later when I arrive home, the child is alone with me: his name is Idrees, and he is so beautiful that for a second I wonder if he is a girl: The child is very healthy, white skinned, has blond hair, and with colorful (very light green, close to blue) eyes. Then I think if he is my child, then I will be able to breastfeed him because I should have milk in my breasts. I offer my left breast, and the baby accepts? then I try my right breast, and again he accepts. I quickly stop, and kiss the child?s mouth? then I woke up. 1731 views Q. Istikhara 2714 views Q.
